title: Oracle Admin I
description: Oracle Admin I is your entry into one of enterprise IT's most dependable careers. You'll set up Oracle database instances from scratch, create and secure users, manage tablespaces, and run your first backups — the daily bread of a working database administrator. Every session is live and one-on-one, so you learn on real database problems, not slides.
detailParagraphs: Oracle is the database engine behind a huge share of banking, ERP and enterprise systems, and administering it well is a specialised, well-paid skill. That is exactly what this live Oracle Admin I course prepares you for.
Expect to spend most of your time actually doing the work — you’ll install and configure Oracle database instances and tune queries and monitor performance along the way.
You finish with practical work you can show an employer, not just a certificate.
keyPoints: Install and configure Oracle database instances
Run backup and recovery with RMAN

contentSections.heading: Architecture & Installation
paragraphs: How an Oracle instance is structured — memory, processes, storage — and a clean install from scratch.

contentSections.heading: Users, Roles & Security
paragraphs: Creating schemas, granting privileges, and locking the database down the way real admins do.

contentSections.heading: Storage & Tablespaces
paragraphs: Managing datafiles, tablespaces and undo so the database stays healthy as data grows.

contentSections.heading: Backup & Recovery
paragraphs: RMAN backups, restore scenarios and the recovery drills every DBA is expected to know.

contentSections.heading: Performance & Monitoring
paragraphs: Reading AWR reports, spotting slow SQL and keeping the instance responsive under load.

title: SQL
description: Almost every application on earth stores its data in a database, and SQL is how you talk to it. This course takes you from writing simple queries to joining data across tables, grouping and aggregating for real reports, and designing schemas that stay fast as they grow. You finish able to pull exactly the data anyone asks for.
detailParagraphs: SQL is taught here as a hands-on, live one-on-one course rather than a stack of videos. Almost every application stores its data in a database, so being fluent in querying and designing one is a foundational skill across tech.
You will use indexes to speed things up and design normalised schemas, guided by an instructor who has done this work professionally.
Because it’s taught live and personally, questions get answered the moment they come up.
keyPoints: Write queries from simple SELECTs to multi-table joins
Use indexes to speed things up

title: Zbrush 3D
description: ZBrush is the industry's premier digital sculpting tool, used to create the detailed characters and assets you see in films and games. This course covers sculpting techniques, detailing, texturing and preparing models for production. It's a creative, high-skill course for anyone serious about 3D art.
detailParagraphs: Zbrush 3D is taught here as a hands-on, live one-on-one course rather than a stack of videos. From architectural walkthroughs to game and film assets, 3D and animation skills feed a fast-growing media and visualisation industry.

Every session is one-on-one, so the pace bends to you — not to a class average.
